_doc: Input for arrange.py --arc: the target loudness of each FILM bar in dB relative to the track's loud bars (0 = its biggest sections, -6 = a groove, -10 = a breakdown, -14 = a soft intro). One number per film bar (bar = beats_per_bar beats at film_bpm). Write it from the picture map in SOUND_BRIEF.md: soft under the cold open and typing, the groove for the feature beats, a breakdown before the turn, the build, the big section from the drop (the hero reveal), a resolve under the logo. This example: a 30 s launch film at 120 BPM = 15 bars, drop on film bar 9 (16.0 s), logo from bar 13.
